settings_security_purpose: Your password, where you're signed in, and how the sign-in cookie is sent.
settings_security_password_signs_out: Changing it signs out every other browser and app session.
settings_security_password_done: Password changed. Every other session was signed out; this browser stays signed in.
settings_security_sessions_help: Sign out everywhere else if you signed in on a shared or lost device. This browser stays signed in.
settings_security_sessions_dialog_body: Every other browser signed in to Lodestar is signed out. People reaching Lodestar through a trusted proxy aren't affected.
settings_security_sessions_done: Every other session was signed out.
settings_security_cookies_help: With secure cookies on, the browser sends the sign-in cookie only over HTTPS. Turn them on when you reach Lodestar through HTTPS (a reverse proxy with a certificate); leave them off on plain HTTP, or nobody can sign in.
settings_security_cookies_env: Set by {env}. Change it there and restart Lodestar.
settings_security_cookies_file: Set with LODESTAR_SECURE_COOKIES or http.secure_cookies in config.toml, then restart. It can't be changed here.
settings_security_cookies_unknown: Couldn't read the secure cookies setting.
settings_security_confirm_help: Lodestar asks for it every time, and doesn't keep it.
settings_security_leave_body: What you typed in Change password will be cleared.
